summary: The first game against a person with Matt's opening as the packet matched Matt's up to the lab (extractors 0:03/0:25, wind 0:11/0:18, lab 0:33; the ledger records that the user called it better). Then the lab chose a second constructor at 0:53, three seconds into the first, so the first Pawn came at 1:40 (Matt's at 1:12), and the commander built generators one at a time until 2:17, the last two into a full energy store, helping the lab only from 2:24. The person, by his own account at 4:20 ('2 mex, wind because the speed was high. one construction bot expanding all else was pawns'), had Pawns at D4 by 2:08 and four by 2:17. Ours met them in groups of two and three, 600 to 1,000 from our commander, and by 3:00 we had lost 5 Pawns, both constructors, 4 wind, a solar and 2 extractors (plus the frame at spot_16) against 3 of his. A three-Pawn group then chased east to F3 while the wind field burned, energy sat at zero from 3:30 to 4:00, and the Maces (from 2:52) and two light-turret frames came too late. 11 to 14 Pawns killed the split Maces and then the lab at 4:54, and the record ends at 5:03 with our commander at 14% health among 11 Pawns.

root.what: The lab picked a second constructor while the first was 3 s into its build. The 0:33 packet had asked for 'a second constructor when we have only one', and the lab's words read '0 constructors and 1 more being made'. That constructor stood at 1:40, the first Pawn started at 1:40 instead of about 1:16, and the second constructor walked to spot_16 (D4) and died at 2:18. The same chain kept the commander on generators until 2:24 (Matt's commander helped the lab from 1:36). With Pawns at D4 by 2:08 and four by 2:17, we met the rush with three Pawns. Owners: the packet (an ambiguous count) and the hands (they do not keep counts).

bears_on.note: This game is one of the block's sources (its opponent's '2 mex, wind ... all else was pawns', 4:20). Our second constructor before any Pawn, followed by a loss to all-Pawns, bears out 'more than 1 or two construction bots will make defending yourself hard'. The block dates these games 2026-09-19/20, but the batch stamps say 2026-09-21 evening EDT.
The commander was on generators until 2:17 and on the lab only from 2:24 (Matt's from 1:36). The Pawn interval fell from 11-12 s to 4-5 s once it helped.
Our raiders fought in bodies of one to three (group_A at D4 2:12-2:32, group_B in the east 2:54-3:14, group_F alone at E4 4:31) and lost each fight.

Seen from the receiving side: his first Pawns were at D4 by 2:08 and killed our expanding constructor at 2:18. Our greedy start (a second constructor, far spots) is exactly what that pressure punishes.

tools: record-0.jsonl events and samples read directly
lens.caveats: There is no truth file, so his numbers are only what we saw: minutes.py's 4:00 'window' at 5.4x is one Pawn in sight, not a lead. pro_baseline was not run (Quicksilver has no cards); Matt's line in docs/knowledge/openings.md served as the reference. hands_window prints only the plays for this 2026-09-21 log format, so the lab's and commander's ratings were read from the jev rows. chat.jsonl marks all four lines speaker '?', but the record's chat events say player 1 (ours) typed 0:39, 3:29 and 4:25 and player 0 (the opponent) typed 4:20. The ledger's 'the store never below 700' does not match the record: energy was 0 at 1:20 and from 3:30 to 3:50, and metal 214-251 from 2:00 to 3:20. analyze_match shows outcome None (no results file for a lobby game); the end comes from the record's last sample (5:03) and bot.log ('Connection reset by peer'). The date is 2026-09-21 23:20 EDT local, which is 2026-09-22 UTC and the ledger's era.
